title: All-in-One Multi-Industry Edition • Licensing & Security Update

Monthly Free Plan Quotas: 40 Invoices/Mo, 30 Quotations/Mo, 20 Job Sheets/Mo, and 25 Products with strict Anti-Delete bypass protection.
Date-Locked Cryptographic Activation Keys: Hardware-bound HMAC-SHA256 keys with embedded expiry protection and masked input security.
Multi-Industry First-Install Setup: Select Business Type & Modules during setup with Owner Master PIN lock.
Customer Old Due / Opening Balance: Add pre-existing customer balances directly into Customer Ledger & Receive Payment.
In-App 1-Click Auto Update: Automatically receive update notifications, download, and install new features in-app.
fixes: Prevented Free Plan monthly quota reset when deleting Invoices, Quotations, Job Sheets, or Products.
Excluded Opening Balance entries from Today/Monthly Sales & GST revenue totals while keeping Ledger accurate.
Optimized Windows Defender & SmartScreen compliance with signed installer and non-solid compression.
